name: _close.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  preferences/_close.scss — the circular WebGL pref-close button + canvas, shared by the preferences dialog header.
//  Imported by preferences.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

$_B_PREF_CLOSE: 'pref-close';

// Circular close button (WebGL X canvas inside).
.#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: to-rem($space-3xl);
  height: to-rem($space-3xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background: var(--border-color);
  transition:
    background 0.2s ease,
    transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;

  // WebGL Canvas
  .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    display: block;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas.is-fallback {
    display: none;
  }

  // CSS-drawn X via pseudo-elements: canvas absent or WebGL unavailable
  &:not(:has(.#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas)),
  &:has(.#{$_B_PREF_CLOSE}-canvas.is-fallback) {
    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-xl);
      height: to-rem($space-hairline + 1);
      background: var(--text-secondary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    &::before {
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }
    &::after {
      transform: rotate(-45deg);
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      background: var(--border-color-hover, var(--border-color));

      &::before {
        transform: rotate(135deg);
      }
      &::after {
        transform: rotate(45deg);
      }
    }
  }
}
